title: NativQA Framework: Enabling LLMs with Native, Local, and Everyday Knowledge
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings on the topic of religion. The main finding is that the NativQA framework is effective for creating large-scale, culturally and regionally aligned Question-Answer datasets across multiple languages and locations. This includes data on the topic of religion. The study also found that LLMs like GPT-4o are highly capable of performing QA annotation within this framework, showing strong agreement with human evaluators.
